connector.name: MCP by siteglass.io
connector.registryDescription: Archive any URL to a shareable rrweb/pdf/png snapshot + agent-driven web QA (scan, run E2E flows).
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package siteglass-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace io.siteglass, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SITEGLASS_API_KEY
env.description: siteglass API key (optional; the server auto-creates an account if absent).
